{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored trousers, straight cut, ankle length, charcoal grey #4A4D52, wool-blend suiting with a subtle texture

Blouse, classic fit with a soft collar, hip-skimming, long sleeves, ivory #F2EBDD, matte crepe or fine cotton-silk

Textured blazer, single-breasted, slightly relaxed, hip length, heather camel #B58E64, wool tweed-style weave

Light autumn coat, straight cut, knee length, deep olive #4F5A43, brushed wool

Loafers, almond toe, low block heel, dark chocolate #3B2A22, smooth leather

Belt, slim, dark chocolate #3B2A22, smooth leather with a small gold-tone buckle

Tote bag, structured, medium size, dark chocolate #3B2A22, grained leather

Scarf, lightweight, sage green #9DAE9A, fine merino wool

Why this outfit works: The neat business look pairs tailored trousers, a crisp blouse and a textured blazer with loafers, which suits a day in the office. The warm camel and ivory sit well against her golden-toned skin and honey-blonde hair, while the sage scarf echoes the soft green-grey of her eyes. The olive coat covers the cool autumn mornings and stays in the same muted, earthy palette, so everything combines easily. The straight trousers and the hip-length blazer keep the proportions balanced and comfortable for sitting and moving through a working day."}
